# Caudal de Hierro

**Status: DRAFT** · world: [deepinterior](../lore/worlds/deepinterior.md) · kind: new · stage: space · id: `caudal_de_hierro`

## Niche

- **Habitat:** Liquid outer core boundary layer (approx. 2,900 km depth)
- **Diet:** Magnetic shear and convective entropy gradients
- **Active:** Continuous (phase-locked to tidal cycle)
- **Predators:** none

## Body

Highly speculative fantasy: gossamer helical filaments of self-organizing iron-sulfur plasma; 10-50 km in length; no fixed mass, just persistent pattern. No carbon chemistry or solvent exists here.

**Temperament:** Aloof, rhythmic, indifferent to solid matter
